```
['create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet with a pymatgen Structure', 'create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE structure relaxation using OMat24RelaxSet with a pymatgen Structure', 'create VASP input files for an OMat24 ab initio molecular dynamics run using OMat24AIMDSet with temperature and thermostat settings', 'configure the OMat24AIMDSet ensemble to nvt or npt with nose or langevin thermostat options', 'review the INCAR updates generated by OMat24RelaxSet or OMat24AIMDSet for VASP calculation parameters']
```
